value.message: Bucket ACL is "public-read", which makes its objects readable by anyone on the internet.
value.remediation: Set the ACL to "private" and grant access through a bucket policy or IAM.

value.message: Bucket versioning status is "Suspended". An overwrite or delete is unrecoverable.
No access logging is configured for this bucket, so reads of its objects leave no trail.
value.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_logging resource pointing at a log bucket.

value.message: No aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block covers this bucket, so a later ACL or policy change can expose it without tripping any control.
value.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block for this bucket with all four settings true.

value.message: No server-side encryption configuration is declared for this bucket.
value.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration with AES256 or aws:kms.

value.message: Policy allows "*" against every resource in the account. * can be scoped to an ARN.
value.remediation: Replace "*" with the ARNs this policy is meant to cover.

value.message: Policy allows the wildcard action "*". Anything holding this policy can perform every operation the wildcard covers, not the ones the application needs.
value.remediation: Replace the wildcard with the specific actions this principal calls.

value.message: This configuration provisions 5 IAM or S3 resource(s) and no CloudTrail. Without one there is no record of who used them.
value.remediation: Add an aws_cloudtrail with a log bucket, or confirm the account already has an organisation trail covering it.
